SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS PLANT , KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO , KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , KEY_3 AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'CHSG' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(LEGACY_PO_COUNT,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, ISNULL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, CASE WHEN PRE_GR_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'S' ELSE ' ' END AS DOC_TYPE INSPECTOR_NAME + '^' + INSPECTOR_DEPT_NAME AS IV_COLUMN FROM V_KEP_PO WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_COUNT='$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_COUNT$' ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_COUNT
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_COUNT$' AND IF_FLAG= 'N'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_COUNT$' AND IF_FLAG= 'N'
